Every bag is built with strong fabrics, reinforced stitching, smooth zippers and comfortable straps, so it looks good and lasts through years of daily use. We work with you from the first sketch to the final dispatch, making sure the finished product matches your vision, budget and timeline.

Businesses choose us because a well-made bag keeps your brand visible every single day. Our custom corporate backpacks are ideal for employee welcome kits, conferences, trade shows, product launches and client gifting. Many companies also order company logo backpacks as rewards for staff and partners, turning a simple gift into a lasting reminder of your brand. For bulk orders tied to events or campaigns, our custom backpacks for businesses come with consistent quality, uniform colours and dependable delivery schedules.Your logo deserves the right finish. Looking for custom backpacks with logo? We offer embroidery for a premium textured feel, screen printing for bold colours, rubber patches for a modern look and heat transfer for detailed artwork. Our custom printed backpacks keep their colours sharp even after heavy use and repeated washing.

Our design team shares digital mock-ups before production, so you can approve placement, size and colours with complete confidence. We also help with fabric selection, from polyester and nylon to canvas and recycled materials, matching each order to your use case and budget.Personal touches make every bag special. Our personalised backpack collection covers every age and need, from school and college to travel and trekking. Parents and schools choose our personalised childrens backpack and personalized kindergarten backpack for their lightweight build, soft padded straps and child-safe materials.

A childrens backpack personalised with a name, cartoon or class badge also helps little ones recognise their bag instantly. Adults can order personalized backpacks for adults in casual, travel, gym and trekking styles. With names, initials or artwork, each backpack personalised by us feels truly unique. For gifting, personalized backpacks make thoughtful presents for birthdays, farewells and festive occasions.Our reach goes well beyond one city. ## custom backpacks for businesses

Frequently Asked Questions

​

1\. What is the minimum order for custom backpacks with logo?

MOQ depends on the style and material. Contact us for a bulk quote on logo orders or custom backpacks for businesses.

​

2\. Can I get a custom laptop backpack with padding?

Yes. Every model can include padded compartments, water-resistant fabric, anti-theft zips and USB ports.

​

3\. Do you make bags for children?

Yes. We make a personalised childrens backpack and a personalized kindergarten backpack in bright, child-safe designs. Every childrens backpack personalised by us can carry a name, cartoon or school logo.

​

4\. Which branding methods do you use?

Company logo backpacks can be embroidered, screen printed or fitted with woven patches. For custom printed backpacks, we use high-quality digital and screen printing.

​

5\. Can you supply backpacks for corporate events?

Yes. We deliver custom corporate backpacks in bulk for conferences, onboarding and gifting. A laptop backpack with company logo is our most popular choice.

​

6\. Do you offer adult and single-piece orders?

We make personalized backpacks for adults in many styles. You can order a sample personalised backpack before placing a larger order.

​

7\. How long does production take?

Sampling takes a few days. Bulk personalized backpacks usually ship within 2–4 weeks, depending on quantity and design.

​

8\. Do you deliver outside Mumbai and India?

Yes. We supply across India and to international destinations with secure packaging and reliable logistics.
